title: Runtime behavior
responsibility: Shows recorded end-to-end behavior and comparison without presenting pending reads as verified changes.

inputs.name: RuntimeBehavior.result
inputs.description: Required behavior rows, scenarios, scope and after-side record. Comparison has two sides only for commit mode with a parent.

inputs.name: RuntimeBehavior.evidence
inputs.description: Read state: undefined is pending, null is failure, populated data supplies comparison input. Refusal messages are forwarded to run panels.

inputs.name: RuntimeBehavior.unit
inputs.description: Optional function identifier forwarded to result rows on both sides.

outputs.name: RuntimeBehavior
outputs.description: Current or compared behavior with verdict/reasons, result groups, recorded duration and scenario outcomes. Pending reads show a reading verdict unless already fixed as not-compared or unknown with a reason. Failed reads say Behavior unknown. Missing groups or duration are explicitly marked absent.
